shared_elements: low-relief carved rectangular panel with a border/frame
rows of repeated units of similar size
justification: Both show a bordered rectangular field subdivided into horizontal registers of repeated, similarly sized carved units, and both include a small hand-like motif among rounded curvilinear forms. Beyond that generic scheme the content differs entirely: A is built from abstract geometric ornament (zigzag band, interlace border, rows of pendant leaf/feather tongues) with a fragmentary figural element, while B is a grid of squarish cartouches each containing a compact face-like sign, a sign-block convention with no counterpart in A.
